definitions.explanation: A formal request or appeal made to a government body, politician, or authority figure, urging them to take action on a specific issue. More formal and political than a simple request.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{陳情|ちんじょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧{陳情|ちんじょう}{書|しょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A petition requesting road improvements was submitted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}{保護|ほご}→環境保護：15308_kankyouhogo⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}{議員|ぎいん}→国会議員：20949_kokkaigiin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{陳情|ちんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Local fishermen went to petition a member of parliament about environmental protection.

notes:
Used specifically for appeals directed at government officials or political bodies. Differs from {請願|せいがん}, which is a more formal legal procedure with constitutional backing, while {陳情|ちんじょう} is less formal and has no legal requirements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陳情|ちんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to petition)
- {陳情|ちんじょう}{書|しょ} (written petition)
- {陳情|ちんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go petition)
- {陳情|ちんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive a petition)
- {陳情|ちんじょう}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (lobbying activities)
